notes: Both the post-predict and the post-update state and covariance are recorded for every step, so a failure identifies which half of the cycle diverged rather than only that the end result differs.

filterpy's KalmanFilter.update uses the Joseph form for P, which is what gungnir-filters uses too; the agreement below is therefore between two implementations of the same formula, not between two different ones.
